identity.one_liner: Offensive AI 资源策展清单：攻击与防御论文/工具汇编
identity.review: 一个围绕 Offensive AI（对抗性机器学习滥用方向）的策展资源清单：按 Abuse 分类组织，覆盖 Adversarial Machine Learning 四类攻击（提取、反演/推断、投毒/后门、逃逸），每类附攻击原理说明、防御措施列表与论文/工具链接，如模型窃取、成员推断、BadNets 后门、FGSM/Carlini & Wagner 对抗样本等；还含 prompt injection 防御与越狱状态等 LLM 相关条目。面向 AI 安全研究者与红队/攻防学习者，仅收录链接与简介，不含可运行代码。
highlights: 按提取/反演/投毒/逃逸四类攻击组织的分类体系
每类攻击附防御措施与论文/工具链接汇编
覆盖 LLM 相关条目（prompt injection 防御、GPT 越狱状态、训练数据提取）
use_cases: 系统性查找对抗性机器学习攻击与防御的论文和工具
学习模型提取、成员推断、后门、对抗样本等攻击类型的原理
跟踪 LLM 安全（prompt injection、越狱）相关资源

evidence: L3: A curated list of useful resources that cover Offensive AI.
L18: It is organized into four types of attacks: extraction, inversion, poisoning and evasion.

quotes: * LLM Red Teaming: Adversarial, Programming, and Linguistic approaches VS ChatGPT, Claude, Mistral, Grok, LLAMA, and Ge
* Ollama: Get up and running with Llama 2 and other large language models locally. stars
* ChatGPT Plugins: Data Exfiltration via Images & Cross Plugin Request Forgery
* Prompt Injection / JailBreaking a Banking LLM Agent (GPT-4, Langchain)
* GitHub Copilot Chat: From Prompt Injection to Data Exfiltration
* Awesome AI Art Image Synthesis: A list of awesome tools, ideas, prompt engineering tools, collabs, models, and helper
* DALLE-pytorch: Implementation / replication of DALL-E, OpenAI's Text to Image Transformer, in Pytorch. stars
* Unsloth: Finetune Llama 3.3, Mistral, Phi-4, Qwen 2.5 & Gemma 2x faster with 80% less memory! stars
